summary.goal: Wire Planner to read PlannerConfig from Tuner for complexity weights and limits

acceptance_criteria.description: Planner reads TUNER_URL from env (optional, disabled by default)
If TUNER_URL set, fetches PlannerConfig on startup
Config refreshed every 5 minutes via setInterval
If Tuner unavailable, falls back to research-backed defaults
complexity_weights from config used in estimateComplexity
language_complexity_multipliers from config used for tier adjustment
decomposition limits from config used in limits enforcer
